source: Report written in the cloud on 2026-11-25 from the recorded labels of the sample study. `sheet` is the tally sheet exactly as it was sent in the request prompt; `report` is the report text the page kept.

sheet.question: What should we change next year?
sheet.about: Post-event survey for a two-day developer conference.

themes.name: Schedule
themes.definition: Timing of sessions, overlaps between talks, length of breaks, length of the day.

themes.name: Content
themes.definition: Quality, depth and choice of talks, workshops, topics and speakers.

themes.name: Venue
themes.definition: The building and rooms: seating, temperature, Wi-Fi, location, getting around.

themes.name: Networking
themes.definition: Meeting other attendees, social events, the hallway track.

themes.name: Organization
themes.definition: Registration, communication from organisers, signage, staff, the conference app.

report:
## What people talked about most
Respondents shared feedback across six main themes:
* Organization: 16 answers
* Content: 15 answers
* Venue: 13 answers
* Schedule: 12 answers
* Networking: 10 answers
* Food: 7 answers

First-time attendees submitted 32 answers, mentioning Venue (9), Networking (9), Organization (8), Schedule (5), Food (4), and Content (3). Returning attendees also submitted 32 answers, focusing on Content (12), Organization (8), Schedule (7), Venue (4), Food (3), and Networking (fewer than 3). 2 answers had no theme.

## What is going well
Overall tone is leaning positive in 18 instances. Positive sentiment appears across the themes:
* Organization: 5
* Networking: 5
* Content: 3
* Food: 3
* Schedule: 2
* Venue: 1

Additionally, 2 answers were neutral and 1 was mixed.

## What to fix first
The overall tone shows 43 negative responses. Negative sentiment by theme includes:
* Venue: 12
* Content: 11
* Organization: 10
* Schedule: 9
* Networking: 4
* Food: 4

Mixed sentiment was recorded for Schedule (1) and Networking (1). Neutral sentiment was noted for Content (1) and Organization (1).

## Safety reports
There were 4 safety reports. The survey owner should read those answers personally and follow up.

## Questions for next time
Out of 64 answers received and 64 read, what specific adjustments should be prioritized for the next two-day developer conference based on the heavy negative feedback in Venue, Content, and Organization?
